description: Rows of spec/efuse-otp.md section 2 that bear on the digital partition (rtl/efuse_otp_ctrl.v and its row/column/strobe outputs), each as its verbatim table row. Derived extract for klt signoff item 6 (not_applicable form); the source is spec/efuse-otp.md, bound by sha256. signoff/check-item6-digital.sh fails when the source changes or a row no longer matches.

rows.text: | Array | 256 bits, 32 rows × 8 columns | 8 bits, 1 × 8 | 1 kbit | Exercises row/column decode and tiling; the fallback keeps program and sense paths testable. (0001) |
| Pulse width | 10 µs nominal, controller range 1–100 µs (A3) | — | — | No PDK source. |
| Controller interface | Synchronous: clock, address, program-enable, read-enable, data out, busy | Asynchronous parallel read | Serial interface | (0004) |

| Controller behavior | Program only after an explicit registered arm state set after reset release; program drive held inactive in reset and power-up; fixed sense-settle count for read; address stable before enable | — | — | Protection against unintended programming at power-up. (0004) |

| Controller clock | 10 MHz (100 ns period); 100 MHz (10 ns) is not a requirement | — | — | Routed-DEF `klt sta` at 100 ns is constrained with non-negative setup and hold slack at all five library corners; the 10 ns result is out-of-spec headroom, not a failing row. Ratified by operator ruling, issue #35. (0006) |

| PVT corners | Process `typical`, `ff`, `ss`, `fs`, `sf`; T = −40, 25, 125 °C; logic/sense supply 3.3 V ±10% (2.97/3.30/3.63 V); program supply 5.0 V ±10% (4.5/5.0/5.5 V) | — | — | Names confirmed against `sm141064.ngspice`. (0005) |
| Signoff | DRC clean including every `EF.*` rule; LVS clean with the fuse as a recognized device; controller verified (cocotb + Icarus, Yosys, OpenROAD) | — | — | |
